hooks.name: Ghost check on save
hooks.description: Scans the workspace with Haunted Repo's own scanner after every save and fails on a critical finding, so no real key reaches a commit.

hooks.name: Ghost check before the agent stops
hooks.description: Asks the agent to scan what it wrote before it hands back.

action.prompt: Call the haunted-repo MCP tool scan_directory. If it reports a critical or warning ghost, spider or possessed finding in files you changed, fix it before finishing. Never print a raw secret; use the masked value.
